capabilities: Insert an emoji at the cursor position
Search emojis by name in a picker modal
Select emoji skin tone and category
Open the picker via a configurable hotkey
extras: As of November 2024 the picker serves emoji version 15 via the emoji-mart library; the README only covers installation and setup, with no usage examples or screenshots.
intentEvidence: Unlike other plugin this plugin is using the latest versions of the emoji
motivation: The author built it because other plugins and operating system emoji pickers lack up-to-date emoji versions, search, skin tone, and category selection.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in emoji picker, and existing plugins and operating system pickers lack current emoji versions, search, and skin tone selection.

relations.evidence: we are using the emoji-mart library so the emoji version is 15

summary: Emoji picker that opens a searchable modal from the editor toolbar or a hotkey and inserts the selected emoji at the cursor.
